evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/documents/components/DocumentSearchResult.tsx (Story 39.1, rendered by DocumentSearch on the WIRED DocumentsPage — routes/groups/documents.tsx:26/68, routes/lazyRoutes.tsx:12) has NO useTranslation at all (`grep -c useTranslation` = 0) and hardcodes every visible English string: the RLS audience labels SCOPE_LABEL = {organization:'All members', building:'Building', unit:'Unit', user:'Private', public:'Public'} (:14-20) shown in the AudienceBadge and its `Visible to: ${SCOPE_LABEL[scope]}` tooltip (:25,:39); the highlight field labels getFieldLabel 'Title'/'Description'/'Document Content (OCR)'/'AI Summary' (:94-101); the 'Has Summary' badge (:138); `${Math.round(score*100)}% match` (:114) and the `Relevance score: ${score.toFixed(2)}` tooltip (:113).

ppt-web ships sk/cs/de/en, so Slovak/Czech/German users see English-only labels on the document-search results surface. This is NET-NEW: the only prior documents-feature i18n finding (code-review-ppt-web-ui-documents-i18n-hardcoded, 2026-09-16) targeted hardcoded SLOVAK error/empty/loading literals in 7 DIFFERENT files (MoveFolderDialog/DocumentsBrowse/FolderTree/DocumentDetail/FolderTreePage/DocumentPreviewModal/PdfPreview) — it does not name DocumentSearchResult.tsx and concerns a different (sk, not en) string set.

Secondary: the same component also hardcodes `toLocaleDateString('en-US', ...)` for the result date (:64-71), so dates render with US ordering regardless of active locale (the broad hardcoded-en-US-locale finding of 2026-09-20 listed KPICard/RecentPaymentsList/PolicyCard, not this file).

Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): add useTranslation and route all labels through t('documents.search.*') / t('documents.audience.*') keys across the en/sk/cs/de bundles, and derive the date locale from i18n.language (reuse the shared formatDate util introduced by PR #2917). Low severity, i18n gap on a wired customer-facing surface.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/auth/pages/TwoFactorAuthPage.tsx (Epic 9 Stories 9.1/9.2, TOTP 2FA enrollment — a security-critical wired flow using @ppt/api-client useMfa* hooks) renders the setup QR via QrCodeCanvas, whose effect calls `QRCode.toCanvas(canvasRef.current, uri, { width: 200, margin: 2 }).catch(() => {})` (:44-48). The empty catch SILENTLY swallows any QR-generation failure: the <canvas> is left blank with no error text, no aria-live announcement and no guidance. Most users scan the QR, so a silent render failure strands them on the enable step.

There IS a graceful fallback — the TOTP secret is always shown as copyable text below the QR (manualEntrySecret, :332-344) — so this is a degraded-UX / missing-feedback gap rather than a hard dead-end, which is why this is scored Low rather than Medium.

Related same-file weakness: the error paths surface RAW error text to the user via `message: String(err)` on setup (:139-140) and `setFormError(String(err) ...)` on verify/disable/regen (:158,:183,:209), echoing backend/exception strings untranslated on a security page. (The raw-error-to-user pattern is already filed for other surfaces — errorboundary-raw-message-prod, emergency-dir-raw-err-message, loginpage-raw-error-message — but is net-new for the 2FA page; no prior ppt-web-ui signal or backlog row touches features/auth 2FA.)

Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): on QR failure set an error state that renders a translated 'QR unavailable — use the manual key below' notice (and log via the app error channel) instead of an empty catch; map known MFA error statuses to translated t('auth.twoFactor.*') copy instead of String(err). Add a Vitest case asserting the fallback notice renders when QRCode.toCanvas rejects. Low severity, silent-failure + i18n on a security surface.
